create_render_pipeline: create a RenderPipeline component that manages deferred rendering with shadow maps, GBuffer, SSAO, blur, lighting, bloom, and FXAA
register_model_for_rendering: register a 3D model with the RenderPipeline for rendering with position, rotation axis, rotation angle, scale, and color parameters
render_deferred_pipeline: render the full deferred pipeline including shadow maps, GBuffer, SSAO shadows, blur, lighting, bloom, debug, and FXAA anti-aliasing
create_gbuffer: create a GBuffer with color, normal, and depth texture attachments for deferred rendering at a specified width and height
create_shadow_map: create a shadow map framebuffer with a depth texture attachment for directional light shadow rendering at a specified resolution
